title: DOW-UAP-D56, Range Fouler Debrief, Arabian Sea, August 2020
doc_notes: This document is a U.S. Navy Range Fouler Debrief Form detailing an encounter with three unidentified air contacts in the North Arabian Sea, containing some redactions.

incidents.summary: A U.S. Navy pilot observed three unidentified small air contacts while conducting routine operations in the North Arabian Sea.
behavior: maintain relative course, speed, and altitude
incidents.quote: observed 3x possible unidentified small air contacts while conducting routine operations in the North Arabian Sea
